seo.title: About ISTAM
seo.description: Discover ISTAM's mission, values and teaching approach as a professional training organization.

hero.title: Growing skills, sustainably
hero.description: ISTAM designs and delivers practical professional training, built to have a real impact on teams and organizations.

intro.title: A team of practitioners, not just educators
intro.paragraph1: ISTAM was founded on a simple observation: professional training has the most impact when it's led by experts who have themselves worked in the fields they teach.
intro.paragraph2: From the start, we've designed pathways that combine pedagogical rigor, immediate practice and long-term follow-up — for skills that stick, well after the training ends.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Give professionals and organizations the concrete skills they need to progress, through training grounded in real-world practice.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: Make continuous learning a natural reflex in every organization — a measurable investment, not just an obligation.

expertise.title: Field expertise
expertise.description: Trainers who practice or have practiced the profession they teach, not only educators.

impact.title: Measurable impact
impact.description: Every program is built around clear objectives and progress that can genuinely be observed.

integrity.title: Rigor and transparency
integrity.description: Clear commitments on content, expected outcomes and how each training unfolds.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.description: Human support, from the first conversation with an advisor through to follow-up after training.

approach.title: A method built for impact
approach.description: Every ISTAM program follows the same methodological rigor, from initial diagnosis to results follow-up.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.description: Understand your teams' real needs before designing the program.

design.title: Design
design.description: Build a learning pathway suited to participants' level and objectives.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: Deliver the training with hands-on scenarios and a trainer who is an expert in the subject.

followUp.title: Follow up
followUp.description: Measure progress and support the application of new skills over time.

cta.title: Want to know more about our training programs?
cta.description: Our advisors are here to help you find the program best suited to your goals.
